trustTitle: Service should be driven by compassion, not by profit.
trustDescription: Kailash ki Karuna is a community service initiative built around personal commitment. The founders do not solicit public donations or religious subscriptions. Our focus is on making practical help accessible and treating every family with dignity.
beginningTitle: A thought that grew into a commitment to serve.
beginningText1: The roots of this work grew in Jodhpur. The belief was simple: when someone around us faces difficulty, the community should try to stand beside them.
beginningText2: What began as local efforts to help people with practical community needs gradually developed into a more organised effort to support families during difficult times.
inspirationEyebrow: THE JOURNEY THAT INSPIRED THE NAME
inspirationTitle: The spirit of Kailash, brought into everyday life.
inspirationText1: In 2016, founder Raju Vyas, Chandra Harsh undertook the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra. The experience left a deep impression on him and strengthened his desire to make compassion part of everyday action.
inspirationText2: They chose The name Kailash ki Karuna — the compassion of Kailash — to express the spirit behind their work: to serve people with humility, without discrimination and without seeking personal gain.
inspirationQuote: Let faith find its expression through service.
kailashImagePlaceholder: A photograph from the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra
kailashImageCaption: The inspiration behind the name — Kailash Mansarovar.
journeyTitle: From local action to a lifeline for families.
journeyDescription: Each chapter has been shaped by a need in the community and a willingness to step forward.
chapterOneText: Early efforts focused on local community challenges, including public cleanliness, seasonal health concerns and helping families find support during emergencies.
chapterTwoTitle: A pilgrimage that shaped a purpose
chapterTwoText: Following the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, Raju Vyas and Chandra Harsh committed themselves to building a service initiative inspired by compassion.
chapterThreeText: During dengue outbreaks, the team undertook community fogging efforts in residential areas to support local mosquito-control initiatives.
chapterFourTitle: Standing with families during the pandemic
chapterFourText: During the COVID-19 crisis, a section of Surajdevi Roopa Devi Pushtikar Private School was converted into a local isolation and patient-support facility, with food and basic care arrangements.
chapterFiveTitle: Building a free medical equipment bank
chapterFiveText: The initiative grew into a medical equipment bank that helps families access essential home-care equipment when they need it.
bankTitle: A medical equipment bank that keeps helping, one family at a time.
bankDescription: Medical equipment can be expensive, especially when a family needs it for a limited period during recovery. Our Nishulk Chikitsa Upkaran Bank helps families access essential equipment for home care.
bankProcess: Equipment is requested, availability and applicable conditions are explained, and the item is provided according to the organisation's process. After use, returned equipment can be prepared for the next family.
bankImagePlaceholder: With DGI Prashant Kumar at our medical equipment bank

otherSevaDescription: Our work has also included initiatives that respond to everyday public needs.
sevaFoggingText: Fogging efforts in residential areas during local dengue and mosquito-related health concerns.
sevaWaterText: Jalgrah initiatives that provide drinking water to people during the hot Rajasthan summer.
sevaEmergencyText: Practical assistance and coordination for families facing difficult situations.
foundersTitle: Ordinary people. A lasting commitment to serve.
foundersDescription: The work of Kailash ki Karuna is shaped by the dedication of its founders, who balance their professional lives with a commitment to community service.
rajuBio: A government school headmaster in Pratap Nagar, Jodhpur, Raju Vyas leads the initiative's field coordination, equipment procurement and service logistics beyond his professional responsibilities.
chandraBio: A Senior Grade-One Nurse at Umaid Hospital, Jodhpur, Chandra Harsh brings clinical experience to the initiative and contributes to equipment-care, sanitisation and medical operations.

stories.title: The Kailash Mansarovar journey
stories.excerpt: The pilgrimage that inspired the spirit and name of Kailash ki Karuna.
content: In 2016, Raju Vyas undertook the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra. The experience became an important part of the inspiration behind the service initiative.
The name Kailash ki Karuna expresses the founders' wish to translate the spirit of compassion into practical service for people in Jodhpur.
stories.alt: Mount Kailash and the surrounding landscape

stories.title: The roots of community service
stories.excerpt: How local efforts in Chopasni Housing Board grew into a wider service initiative.
content: The early roots of the initiative were in the neighbourhoods of Chopasni Housing Board, Jodhpur.
Local efforts focused on practical community needs and helping families during difficult situations. These experiences helped shape the direction of Kailash ki Karuna.
stories.alt: Early community service work in Jodhpur

stories.title: A helping hand for home care
stories.excerpt: The medical equipment bank helps families access equipment needed during recovery.
content: Families may need medical equipment at home for a limited period, and purchasing every item can be difficult.
The Nishulk Chikitsa Upkaran Bank helps families request essential equipment. Availability and applicable conditions are explained as part of the process.
stories.alt: Medical equipment available through the equipment bank

stories.title: Supporting neighbourhood health efforts
stories.excerpt: Community fogging efforts during local dengue and mosquito-related health concerns.
content: During local dengue outbreaks, the team undertook fogging efforts in residential areas to support mosquito-control initiatives.
These efforts reflect the initiative's wider commitment to responding to practical needs within the community.
stories.alt: Community service activity in a residential area

stories.title: Support during an unprecedented crisis
stories.excerpt: The local isolation and patient-support initiative during the pandemic.
content: During the COVID-19 pandemic, a section of Surajdevi Roopa Devi Pushtikar Private School was converted into a local isolation and patient-support facility.
The initiative included arrangements for basic patient support and food for people in need during a difficult period.
stories.alt: Community support initiative during the COVID-19 pandemic

stories.title: A little relief in the summer heat
stories.excerpt: Jalgrah initiatives that provide drinking water to people in Rajasthan's summer.
content: Public drinking-water booths, known as Jalgrah, are another part of the community service work.
They are intended to provide drinking water to labourers, commuters and pedestrians during the hot summer months.
